newsitem.title: CHINA: China retail sales seen up 19.8 pct in January.
newsitem.headline: China retail sales seen up 19.8 pct in January.

text.p: China's retail sales were expected to be 228.7 billion yuan in January, up by 19.8 percent compared with the same period in 1996, the China Securities newspaper said on Thursday.

Retail sales increases in January would be influenced by hectic shopping before the Chinese lunar new year that falls on February 7 this year, it said, quoting the Information Centre of the State Economic and Trade Commission.
The commission expected a stable increase in sales for this year, it said.
